name: Benghuai Xueyuan 2
source:
On March 28, 2014, a disaster called "Houkai" broke out in Chiba High School, Nagazora City. Kiana, who claims to be the "Valkyrie", embarked on her own destiny. 

[From [url=https://houkai2nd.fandom.com/wiki/Houkai_Gakuen_2_Wiki]Houkai Gakuen Wiki[/url]]
translation:
2014年3月28日，名为“崩坏”的灾难在长空市千羽学园爆发。自称“女武神”的琪亚娜，踏上了属于自己的命运之路。

[摘自[url=https://houkai2nd.fandom.com/wiki/Houkai_Gakuen_2_Wiki]Houkai Gakuen Wiki[/url]]
